presets.name: Mono check
presets.description: Sums both channels to mono, to hear how the mix holds up on one speaker.

presets.name: Invert polarity
presets.description: Flips both channels' polarity, to line one microphone up against another.

presets.name: Pad -6 dB
presets.description: Turns the level down 6 dB, for headroom before the next module.

presets.name: Wide
presets.description: Widens the stereo image by half again; check it in mono.

presets.name: Remove DC
presets.description: Takes out a DC offset that wastes headroom and clicks at edits.
